class.name: StudioSystem
class.brief_description: The main system object for FMOD Studio.

method.name: create
method.description: This function creates the studio system.

method.name: flush_commands
method.description: Block until all pending commands have been executed.

method.name: flush_sample_loading
method.description: Block until all sample loading and unloading has completed.

method.name: get_bank
method.description: Retrieves a loaded bank with the specified file path.

method.name: get_bank_by_id
method.description: Retrieves a loaded bank with the specified ID.

method.name: get_bank_count
method.description: Retrieves the number of currently-loaded banks.

method.name: get_bank_list
method.description: Retrieves a list of the currently-loaded banks.

method.name: get_bus
method.description: Retrieves a loaded bus.

method.name: get_bus_by_id
method.description: Retrieves a loaded bus.

method.name: get_event
method.description: Retrieves an EventDescription of an event or snapshot with the specified file path.

method.name: get_event_by_id
method.description: Retrieves an EventDescription.

method.name: get_final_parameter_by_id
method.description: Retrieves a global parameter value by unique identifier. finalvalue is the final value of the parameter after applying adjustments due to automation, modulation, seek speed, and parameter velocity to value. This is calculated asynchronously when the Studio system updates.

method.name: get_listener_attenuation_position
method.description: Gets the attenuation position of the listener. (Corresponds to getListenerAttributes)

method.name: get_listener_transform
method.description: Gets the transform of the listener. (Corresponds to getListenerAttributes)

method.name: get_listener_velocity
method.description: Gets the velocity of the listener. (Corresponds to getListenerAttributes)

method.name: get_num_listeners
method.description: Retrieves the number of listeners.

method.name: get_parameter_by_id
method.description: Retrieves a global parameter value by unique identifier.

method.name: get_parameter_label_by_id
method.description: Retrieves a global parameter label by ID.

method.name: get_parameter_label_by_name
method.description: Retrieves a global parameter label by name, including the path if needed.

method.name: get_vca
method.description: Retrieves a loaded VCA.

method.name: get_vca_by_id
method.description: Retrieves a loaded VCA.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Initializes the Studio System.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Checks that the System reference is valid and has been initialized.

method.name: load_bank_file
method.description: Loads the metadata of a bank. This does not load the bank's sample data.

method.name: load_bank_memory
method.description: Loads the metadata of a bank from memory. Does not load the bank's sample data.

method.name: load_command_replay
method.description: Load a command replay.

method.name: lookup_id
method.description: Retrieves the ID for a bank, event, snapshot, bus or VCA.

method.name: lookup_path
method.description: Retrieves the path for a bank, event, snapshot, bus or VCA.

method.name: release
method.description: Shut down and free the Studio System object.

method.name: set_listener_attributes
method.description: Sets the 3D attributes of the listener.

method.name: set_listener_attributes_with_attenuation
method.description: Sets the 3D attributes and attenuation position of the listener.

method.name: set_num_listeners
method.description: Sets the number of listeners in the 3D sound scene.

method.name: set_parameter_by_id
method.description: Sets a global parameter value by unique identifier.

method.name: set_parameter_by_id_with_label
method.description: Sets a global parameter value by unique identifier, looking up the value label.

method.name: set_parameters_by_ids
method.description: Sets multiple global parameter values by unique identifier.

method.name: start_command_capture
method.description: Start recording Studio API commands to a file.

method.name: stop_command_capture
method.description: Stop recording Studio API commands.

method.name: unload_all
method.description: Unloads all currently loaded banks.

method.name: update
method.description: Update the studio system.
